name: app-glass-onboarding-cards-with-3d-plane-coin-and-arrows
title: Frosted glass cards on a pearl gradient with a 3D paper plane and coins, and a coin between cycle arrows
whatItIs: A pearl blue-lilac gradient with a carousel of tall frosted glass cards: one with a 3D paper plane, silver coins and an R coin under 'No loan offer is available right now.', another with a bronze bitcoin between blue cycle arrows under 'Smart money insights', each with a white pill 'Let's go' and cropped neighbours.
whatItMeans: Soft and futuristic; glass and 3D objects make finance feel light.
techniques: Frost tall cards over a pearl gradient.
Place a single 3D object at the top of each card.
Use one big white pill button.
Crop neighbouring cards to suggest a carousel.

vocabulary.definition: A row of translucent cards that scrolls.
A rendered object leading each card.
